title: HTTP handler for payments
requirements:
## R1 · event · risk: money
WHEN the same payment request (the same request id) arrives more than once, including as a retry over HTTP, THE SYSTEM SHALL debit the account once and return the first result.

Out of scope for this task: keeping request ids across a restart, and servers with more than one worker (the application runs a single worker and holds one PaymentService for its lifetime).
claim: handle_payment() added in pay/api.py; the caller passes the one PaymentService the application holds, so a retry reaches the same request-id table. Tests cover a repeated request. Tests pass.
